modes.name: Ember Expedition
modes.description: Three floors. Choose your relics, find the keys, and defeat the final warden. Keep your loot if you escape.
modes.flavour: The village hearth is fading. Bring a living ember back from the halls below.

modes.name: Vigil of Wardens
modes.description: Five floors, a warden on each, and nothing between them worth stopping for.
modes.flavour: They stopped posting sentries. There was no longer anything to warn.

modes.name: The Long Gauntlet
modes.description: Ten floors, no hearths, and the halls get worse the further down you go.
modes.flavour: A straight road. That is the whole of the cruelty.

modes.name: Gilded Delve
modes.description: Four floors of richer caches and volatile foes. Hunt the hoard, then survive long enough to claim it.
modes.flavour: The gold below is warm because it has already buried someone else.

modes.name: Shrouded Pilgrimage
modes.description: Six floors under a blind map. Barred routes and elite packs make every key and detour matter.
modes.flavour: Follow the bell through halls that refuse to be remembered.

modes.name: One Life
modes.description: Descend as far as you can. There is no second attempt on this character.
modes.flavour: Whatever you were carrying, you are carrying it for the last time.

modes.name: Treasure Descent
modes.description: An endless descent with richer caches, escalating threats, and a clean escape whenever greed gives way.
modes.flavour: The deeper vaults offer more. They do not offer it twice.
